reply: I used all 14 tool calls. Searches over pairs of product terms (on a grid of A-powers and t-functions) and several nonlinear families did not reach NMSE below about 8e-3 with the 1/t term included. The best of those was an A^0.5·t^0.5 term with e^(−0.25t). I could not identify the missing structure.

best.code:
def equation(t, A, params):
    return params[0]/t + params[1]*np.exp(-params[2]*t) + params[3]*A**params[4]*t**params[5]*np.exp(-params[6]*A)
